analysis:
Only head-side text of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 408-1327) was supplied. There was no patch or base text, so I could not identify which lines changed. docs/architecture/model-registry.md was supplied as metadata only, with no content, so it was not reviewed.

Security-relevant statements read in the head text:
- Typical MTP acceptance is now the default for eligible sampled rows (lines 659-671). The text says output is approximate and not distribution-exact, and that explicit `exact` opts out. This is a correctness/quality change rather than a confidentiality one. It does not weaken T-008 or T-041. The integrity wording relates loosely to T-007, but the change is operator-controlled and not adversarial.
- Exact Bonsai 9B identities default to paged attention and encrypted SSD prefix caching (lines 762-765). This matches the T-041 default-on posture for CBv2-eligible models. It keeps the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch and the cache identity/security checks (lines 763-764). It adds no new at-rest surface beyond T-041, though T-041 does not name this model class.
- Deadline admission removes the 0.5 rate multiplier (lines 446-450). The deadline catalog is empty. Deadline-profile and environment-guard text (lines 480-488) is availability/timing policy only. It touches no key, attestation or authorization material.
- Several docs describe MiMo media decoding. They say video is read in memory with no disk write (lines 1127-1130), which is consistent with T-050 (provider temp-file plaintext exposure). Media memory is bounded by ledgered quotes.
- MTP idle-upgrade, drain and assistant-download text (lines 551-599, 615-625) matches the existing artifact-validation model. No new network trust boundary is introduced.

No concrete security regression is supported from this text alone.
